source_note: Converted from the supplied 256-page DjVu scan. Copyright page identifies a Bantam Book first published June 1987, with third printing January 1988, ISBN 0-553-34321-1; the back cover bears ISBN 0-553-34676-8. Source artwork and chapter-end notes are retained. Publisher advertisements and redundant preliminary title/contents leaves are omitted from reading text.

comments.edition: Copyright page source 7 establishes title, author, publisher, publication year and internal ISBN; cover mismatch retained as source evidence.
comments.chapters: Printed contents source 8: printed starts 1,35,59,85,113,148,185,214 and Index 242. Visually checked scan openings 10,44,68,94,122,157,194,223,251; printed-page offset -9.
comments.profile_status: Chapter ranges, note region starts/continuations, index gutter, illustration crops and initial verse region visually checked against rendered DjVu pages.
comments.figures: 19 source image regions, including captions and two mathematical expressions. Photographic detail is already missing at sources 109,136,137,139; retained without invented replacement. All 256 source pages surveyed in contact sheets.
comments.notes: Chapter-end notes retain their printed numbers and source page grouping; source 43 continues 42, 156 continues 155 (including note 6), and 222 continues 221.
comments.formulae: Source 209 includes symbolic marks embedded in prose, so the affected paragraphs are retained as a reviewed source facsimile. Source 212 preserves the quantified logic expression only.
comments.primary_ocr: Tesseract is primary except source 43 and 193: direct three-engine comparison shows Vision/Rapid retain bibliography labels that Tesseract drops or separates. Source images confirm the numbered entries.
comments.notes_navigation: Chapter-end notes use source-page group navigation. Individual body superscript-to-numbered-entry links are not reconstructed by this profile.
